verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents drafting feature revisions, requesting review, resolving merge conflicts, and requiring approval before publishing. That covers the versioning and review parts of the story, with approval workflows and exportable audit logs listed in a higher pricing tier. A community comment notes that configuration can't be stored and versioned in the code repository, which limits config-as-code versioning but doesn't contradict in-app revisions. Missing for 10: explicit rollback/revert-to-prior-revision evidence, versioning of automations beyond feature flags (e.g. ramp schedules), git-native config-as-code, and independent hands-on corroboration.
